purpose: Cross-platform contract for the voice-journaling feature (VOICE_PLAN.md). Web, mobile, and portal pin their crypto, mime handling, and language normalization to THIS file; backend tests pin the server side. Copy-and-pin, the repo's established convention (see brain_vectors.json / crisis_phrases.json).

audio_aad.serialization: AES-256-GCM under the patient data key, nonce(12)||ct||tag, base64 in JSON — identical envelope format to entries, only the AAD context differs
audio_aad.notes: Version is the AUDIO PAYLOAD version (independent of the entry content_version). Bump only if the audio envelope format itself ever changes.

added_fields.transcript_lang: ISO 639-1 code of the detected spoken language, or absent when unknown/typed
added_fields.english_text: English translation of the final (possibly edited) transcript, or null when translation was unavailable

example.text: Hoy fue un día difícil en el trabajo.
example.english_text: Today was a hard day at work.

entry_payload_v3.compatibility: Decryptors accept v1/v2/v3; unknown payload versions must fail closed. `english_text` always corresponds to the SAVED text — the client re-translates via POST /audio/translations whenever the transcript was edited after transcription.

mime_types.notes: Clients strip codec parameters before sending the mime. File extensions are ALWAYS derived from the validated server-side mime (never from the client filename). Web records webm/opus or mp4/aac depending on MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported; mobile records m4a/aac.

recording_limits.default_codecs: mono ~24 kbps speech (Opus in webm, AAC in m4a/mp4)

language_normalization.rule: Provider language strings are lowercased; a 2-letter value is already ISO 639-1; known full names map through this table; unknown values are kept as `language_raw` with `language` = null.

error_codes.voice_consent_required: 403 — the account has not granted (or its grant no longer matches) the current STT policy
error_codes.stt_unconfigured: 503 — MINDPATTERN_STT_URL is not set on this server
error_codes.stt_upstream: 502 — the STT provider failed; retry with a fresh recording
error_codes.audio_too_large: 413 — decoded audio exceeds the route body cap
error_codes.audio_storage_unconfigured: 503 — no object store configured (P2: bucket/local dir/dev default)
error_codes.audio_expired: 410 — the attachment's 30-day retention window has passed (P2)
error_codes.unknown_entry: 404 — attachment references a client_entry_id this account never created (P2)
error_codes.consent_voice_share_required: 403 — patient has not shared voice recordings with this therapist (P2)
error_codes.feature_flag: Endpoints under /audio answer a flat 404 (code not_found) when MINDPATTERN_AUDIO_ENABLED is off — the repo's fail-closed convention (deps.require_sharing_enabled); clients discover availability via GET /meta (audio_available).

retention.notes: Transcription-path audio is NEVER persisted anywhere — it exists in server memory for one upstream call. Only explicitly kept recordings become encrypted attachments, expiring after 30 days.
